items.title: Google Rebrands NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook, Unveils Expanded Cloud Features - IT Voice Media
items.raw_summary: Google is officially consolidating its suite of artificial intelligence tools by rebranding its popular research and note-taking assistant, NotebookLM, as Gemini Notebook. The tactical name change moves the platform squarely into Google’s unified Gemini family, placing it alongside core offerings like the standard Gemini app and Gemini Live. Initially introduced to the public during Google I/O 2023 under the working prototype name “Project Tailwind,” the standalone tool has achieved massive global scale. According to Google, the platform has grown to support more than 30 million individual users and over 600,000 active corporate organizations worldwide. Seamless Transition for Existing Users Google
items.title_pt: Google rebranda NotebookLM como Gemini Notebook, revela recursos expandidos na nuvem
items.summary_pt: Consolidação da identidade de marca de ferramenta de IA ao integrar-se à família Gemini.
items.pme_pt: Demonstra como reposicionamento estratégico (rebrand) alinha produto à arquitetura de marca maior, afetando percepção e adoção de mercado.
